title: 第一卷 第25章 学宫圣女说 我愿意嫁第一卷 第26章 周皇胜化龙境大婚继续
slug: 自曝万嗣呈祥父皇给我疯狂赐婚
content_zh:
“原来如此……原来如此……”
林海涛惨笑起来，笑声中充满了自嘲与悲凉。
“难怪……难怪你会心甘情愿地让女儿嫁过去……陛下果然给了你天大的赏赐！”
“为了一个强大的功法，你便出卖了武将的尊严！
李擎苍，我瞧不起你！”
李擎苍面无表情地走到他面前，居高临下地俯视着他。
“废话说完了？”
“说完了，就上路吧。”
话音落下，他抬起手掌，毫不犹豫地朝着林海涛的天灵盖拍去！
就在这千钧一发之际。
一道苍老而悠远的声音，仿佛从九天之上传来，清晰地回荡在每个人的耳边。
“看在老夫的面子上，留他一命。”
那道苍老而悠远的声音落下，李擎苍拍向林海涛天灵盖的手掌，就那么僵在了半空。
一股无形却浩瀚如海的威压，从天而降，笼罩了整个西城门。
在这股威压之下，无论是三百玄甲女兵，还是数百稷下学宫的学子。
尽皆感觉自己宛若蝼蚁，连呼吸都变得无比艰难。
李擎苍这位刚刚实力大进的四极境强者，也感觉到了泰山压顶般的窒息感。
他猛地抬头，望向虚空。
一道身穿朴素灰袍的老者，不知何时已经出现在那里。
他看起来平平无奇，却让李擎苍浑身的汗毛都倒竖起来。

化龙境！
这绝对是化龙境的强者！
那股威压，远非四极境可以比拟！
李擎苍的骨骼在咯咯作响，但他魁梧的身躯依旧挺得笔直。
属于武将的倔强与对皇权的忠诚，让他没有半分退缩。
他对着虚空中的老者，沉声质问。
“阁下莫非也要阻止这场大婚，与我大周为敌不成？”
老者没有理会他，那双浑浊却仿佛能洞穿世间一切的眼睛，落在了地上奄奄一息的林海涛身上。
“逆徒！”
一声怒斥，不响，却饱含着失望与痛心。
“你这是非要将学宫千年的基业，毁于一旦不成？非要让所有同窗，都为你陪葬吗？”
听到这熟悉的声音，林海涛浑身剧震，他挣扎着抬起头，看到那道身影时，脸上浮现出疯狂的笑意。
“院长！
content_en:
"That's it...that's it..."
Lin Haitao laughed miserably, his laughter full of self-deprecation and sadness.
"No wonder...no wonder you are willing to let your daughter marry...His Majesty has indeed given you a huge reward!"
"For a powerful skill, you betrayed the dignity of a military commander!
Li Qingcang, I look down on you! "
Li Qingcang walked up to him expressionlessly and looked down at him condescendingly.
"Are you done talking nonsense?"
"With that said, let's hit the road."
As soon as he finished speaking, he raised his palm and slapped Lin Haitao's Tianling Gai without hesitation!
At this critical moment.
An old and distant voice seemed to come from the sky, echoing clearly in everyone's ears.
"For my sake, let him live."
When the old and distant voice fell, Li Qingcang slapped Lin Haitao's Tianling Gai's palm and froze in mid-air.
An invisible but vast pressure fell from the sky and enveloped the entire west city gate.
Under this pressure, whether it was the three hundred mysterious female soldiers or the hundreds of students from Jixia Academy.
Everyone felt like ants, and even breathing became extremely difficult.
Li Qingcang, a strong man in the Four Extremes Realm who had just made great progress, also felt the suffocation of Mount Tai.
He raised his head suddenly and looked into the void.
An old man wearing a simple gray robe appeared there at some point.
He looked ordinary, but the hair on Li Qingcang's body stood up.
Dragon Transformation Realm!
This is definitely a strong man in the Dragon Transformation Realm!
That coercion is far beyond what the Four Extremes Realm can compare to!
Li Qingcang's bones were creaking, but his burly body remained upright.
The stubbornness of a military commander and his loyalty to the imperial power kept him from flinching.
He asked in a deep voice to the old man in the void.
"Could it be that your Excellency also wants to stop this wedding and become my enemy, Da Zhou?"
The old man ignored him, and his turbid eyes that seemed to be able to penetrate everything in the world fell on Lin Haitao, who was dying on the ground.
"Traitor!"
A scolding, silent, but full of disappointment and pain.
"Do you insist on destroying the academy's thousand-year foundation? Do you insist on having all your classmates buried with you?"
Hearing this familiar voice, Lin Haitao was shaken all over. He struggled to raise his head, and when he saw the figure, a crazy smile appeared on his face.
